setup_man_role: setup the Sphinx man role to add man page link support to documentation
create_man_link_node: create a reference node linking to a man page using a configurable URL template
parse_man_role_text: parse man page text like ls(1) to extract the command name and section number
configure_man_url_regex: configure the man_url_regex setting to customize man page link URLs in Sphinx
review_man_role: review the man_role function to understand how it parses and creates man page links
